component.name: Radix
component.description: With more than enough get up and go to handle your vehicle’s daily energy needs, the Radix from Lightning Power Ltd. is a power plant you can count on to get you where you’re going.

component.name: Denning
component.description: With the Denning, you can now equip an award winning WillsOp radar to your vehicle.

component.name: Adze
component.description: You can now experience the robust data processing of WillsOp in a mobile form factor with the Adze computing system.

component.name: Fridan
component.description: The Fridan is Wen/Cassel Propulsion’s entry-level vehicle cooler. It has proven time and again that it can withstand even the worst environmental conditions, making it an ideal component for your vehicle.

component.name: San'tok.yāi Gimbal Mount
component.description: Line up the perfect shot with help from this S3 gimbal mount. Made by Aopoa specifically for the San'tok.yāi, this gimbal can handle weapons up to S3.

component.name: Thlilye Laser Gatling
component.description: Experience the cutting edge of Xi'an technology with the Thlilye laser gatling, designed by Torral Aggregate. Made exclusively for the Mirai Pulse, this size 2, fully automatic laser gatling features a lightning-quick rate of fire, making it ideal for close-range battle.
